summary: QMMM Holdings Ltd. filed a Form 6-K disclosing receipt of a Nasdaq Staff Delisting Determination on June 17, 2026. NASDAQ determined to delist the company's securities under Listing Rule IM-5101-4 (discretionary authority) and independently for delayed filing of Form 20-F for FY ended September 30, 2025 under Rule 5250(c)(1). The company plans to appeal via an oral hearing before the Nasdaq Hearings Panel, requesting a stay of suspension and an exception to listing standards. There is no assurance the panel will grant relief. The stock remains halted during the process. Watch for the panel's decision on the compliance plan and potential further stay.
